title: Wireframe — Sketch Before You Build
summary: Wireframe = sketch before building — boxes and names, not colors

sections.heading: Orientation — Beginning the Lesson
sections.subtitle: Beginning the Lesson
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **What will you understand?** **Wireframe = sketch before building** — **prevents confusion**.
- **Why now?** **You have a User Flow** — **now turn it into boxes on paper**.
- **What after the lesson?** **You will describe or sketch 3 screens** — **boxes and names, without colors**.

sections.heading: Tension — 'Build an Interface' — and it produces anything
sections.subtitle: 'Build an Interface' — and it produces anything
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **You ask AI to build an interface** — **it produces something general, not what you have in mind**.
- **You edit 5 times**. **Each time is a new guess**. **3 hours wasted**.
- **The problem: you didn't sketch the map first**. **AI guesses — you need to clarify**.

sections.heading: Core idea — the sketch prevents confusion
sections.subtitle: The sketch prevents confusion
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **Wireframe = boxes + names** — **without colors or images**.
- **Its goal is to answer**: **What is at the top of the screen?** **Where is the main button?** **What is the order of the sections?**
- **Paper and pen in 10 minutes > 3 hours editing a wrong interface**.
- **When you describe the Wireframe to AI** — **the result is closer to your mind from the first time**.

sections.heading: Mission — Sketch or Describe 3 Screens
sections.subtitle: Sketch or Describe 3 Screens
sections.contentMarkdown:
**Introduction:** **Sketch or describe — not code**. **Use 3 screens from the previous lesson**. **10–15 minutes**.

**Submission:** **For each screen, provide a Wireframe:**

- **[Section]: [What’s inside]**
- **CTA: [Main button]**

**Evaluation Criteria:**

| Dimension | Weight | Criteria |
|-------|-------|---------|
| 3 described screens | 60% | **Each screen is a bullet list — not a paragraph**. **CTA is clear in each screen** |
| Boxes, no design | 40% | **No colors or fonts — only section names**. **The order is logical — most important first** |
